definition: A courier or operative who delivers physical goods or messages specifically through routes that have no Diaspora coverage — dead zones, shielded corridors, or signal-dark the Gray Zone tunnels. Valued precisely because their work leaves no trace on the network.
origin: Underworld cant; 'phosphene' refers to the light seen when the eye receives no external input — i.e., running blind
usage: Criminal networks, black market operators, E.L.F. sympathizers moving off-grid contraband
example: We don't use the Diaspora for this drop — get a phosphene runner, someone who knows the dark corridors under Old Harbor.
